exposure: Low-dose bupivacaine (7.5 mg) combined with fentanyl (15 microg) in spinal anesthesia
outcome: Maternal side effects (hypotension, bradycardia, respiratory distress)
cohort: Sixty ASA I-II pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean sections under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Low-dose bupivacaine (7.5 mg) with fentanyl (15 microg) provides adequate anesthesia for elective cesarean sections with stable maternal hemodynamics and favorable neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Low-dose bupivacaine (7.5 mg) with fentanyl (15 microg) provides adequate anesthesia for elective CS, a specific mode of birth, with stable maternal hemodynamics and favorable neonatal outcomes.
